item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem:
Priya's grandmother follows a purely lunar calendar in which each month begins with a new Moon. Priya notices that over the years the same lunar month falls in different seasons.

Why does a purely lunar calendar not keep the same months aligned with the same seasons?

options.A: The Moon's phases change more slowly each year
options.B: The seasons are caused by clouds and rainfall
options.C: Twelve lunar months are about 354 days, shorter than the 365-day seasonal year
options.D: The Moon's light is brighter in some seasons
